text:
maria: Seeing OOMs in prod during long-chat generations. Looks tied to KV cache growth + fragmentation, not raw model memory. Repro starts around ~3000 tokens and spikes 10-20% memory until OOM. Posting logs and a quick repro.

maria: ```
[2026-03-16T21:04:12Z] serve: alloc_kv_page failed: could not reserve 32MB (requested 32768 KiB)
[2026-03-16T21:04:12Z] runtime: OOM: arena=kv_cache id=42 pages_alloc=12478 frag_pct=62 reuse_hits=318
[2026-03-16T21:04:12Z] models/generation: cancelled request id=abc123 due to OOM
```

maria: Repro curl (use long_context.txt ~3.5k tokens):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  --data '{"model":"gptx-13b-qat","input_file":"@long_context.txt","max_tokens":1024}'
```

aj: Thanks — can you drop the flamegraph link and the kv counters? do we have per-page-size counters?

maria: Flamegraph: https://internal-graphs/redwood/flame/abcd1234
maria: Quick counters snapshot from the crash host: `kv_pages_total=12478`, `kv_pages_free=420`, `kv_evictions=12`, `kv_reuse_hits=318`, `kv_fragmentation_pct=62`

kai: Looks like the evictor didn't reclaim enough because many pages are partially used (fragmentation). This matches a kernel-selection edge: 4-bit kernels allocate non-uniform page sizes and our compaction path doesn't run on those allocations.

kai: Quick experiment: try forcing page compaction + smaller page size: set `KV_PAGE_COMPACTION=1` and `KV_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE=65536` on the canary and repro.

sam: Short-term mitigations we should consider now:
- soft-alloc fail path: on alloc failure, trim oldest N pages and retry once (no hard crash)
- fallback mode: if fragmentation > 50% then switch to streaming generation (drop KV reuse for tail tokens)
- metric/alerting: emit `kv_eviction_retries` and `kv_fragmentation_pct` and alert at >50% for >5m.

infra-bot: Deployed `kv-compact` canary v0.7.2 to us-west2 with KV_PAGE_COMPACTION=1 (canary-id: canary-88). PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4123

aj: Canary numbers (30m window):
- before: mem_rss 14.8GB, p50 48ms, kv_frag 62%
- after: mem_rss 12.9GB, p50 54ms (+6ms), kv_evictions +120
So compaction reduces memory but increases evictions and slightly higher tail latency.

maria: Confirmed locally with docker image `redwood/serve:canary-kv-0.7.2`. OOM didn't reproduce after compaction, p50 +6ms. Heap profile: https://internal-heap/redwood/heap-1763456789

kai: Longer term we need: compact-on-alloc for quantized kernels, and better page reuse heuristics (prefer coalescing small pages). Also add a fallback retry path: attempt eviction+compaction then a single retry; if that fails, degrade gently (truncate oldest context chunks) and continue streaming. I'll draft a PR for the alloc-fallback.

sam: Make sure to include telemetry for `kv_alloc_fallbacks` and `kv_fallback_success` so we can see effectiveness. Ops wants a dashboard and an alert if fallback count spikes >100/min.

oncall: Rolling compaction flag to prod with auto-rollback policy if OOMs spike. Notifying CS for customers who reported high-context failures. :loudspeaker:

maria: PR #4123 landed to canary; leaving this thread open for 24h to confirm. If anyone sees regressions, paste logs here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
